modules.responsibility: Revision documents, scalar values and stable graph identities
Typed schema, endpoint rules and final-state uniqueness
Ordered edits against a private candidate and logical view comparison
Immutable typed postings and direction-aware multigraph adjacency
Graph query selection, hop and candidate budgets, witnesses and component membership
Strict, versioned encoding and payload integrity
Directory ownership, file installation and head enumeration
Bounded immutable references and graph-scoped handles
Durable publication, head and pin resolution and index construction
HTTP entry, input limits and mapped domain problems

workflows.name: Install and evolve graph schema
steps: Decode the rule definitions
Validate all final entities against the candidate schema
Publish and inspect the durable head
workflows.success: New rules returned at the new revision
workflows.failure: An unsatisfied rule leaves old schema and head intact

workflows.name: Atomically accept a consistent multigraph candidate
steps: Compare expected base to head
Apply ordered edits, then validate endpoint integrity and uniqueness
Install the new image and publish the graphs and indexes together
workflows.success: Two unique values swap at one new revision
workflows.failure: Duplicate, stale and dangling edits never publish

workflows.name: Read a vertex at the selected revision
steps: Select a current or held state
Resolve exact stored vertex identity in the selected graph
workflows.success: Later head returns the newly installed vertex
workflows.failure: The same ID is not found at an older pin

workflows.name: Query typed vertex postings
steps: Resolve the chosen state and validate property kind against its catalog
Read the immutable typed posting and return bounded IDs and exact count
workflows.success: Present text resolves the matching vertex; missing data is not empty text
workflows.failure: Search with wrong scalar type is invalid

workflows.name: Inspect directional incidence
steps: Validate arc kinds against the selected revision
Merge directional rows under one budget and bounded output window
workflows.success: Both-direction results retain parallel arcs and count each loop once
workflows.failure: Unknown arc kind rejects the request

workflows.name: Compute bounded minimum hop distances
steps: Resolve typed directional adjacency
Expand breadth first under a candidate inspection allowance
workflows.success: Return the reachable vertices and minimum depth
workflows.failure: Exhaustion returns no partial distance table

workflows.name: Find a minimum-cost bounded path
steps: Resolve source and destination in the chosen graph
Compare candidate labels by cost, depth and arc sequence under a shared budget
workflows.success: A longer allowance can produce a cheaper witness; tied parallel arcs are deterministic
workflows.failure: Budget exhaustion is distinguishable from no route

workflows.name: Partition the directed graph
steps: Traverse filtered forward and reverse adjacency to find mutual reachability
Deduplicate crossing links by membership and sort the result
workflows.success: Removing one selected arc kind splits a strongly connected group
workflows.failure: Budget exhaustion never returns an incomplete partition

workflows.name: Schedule parallel dependency stages for a target closure
steps: Include every prerequisite through reverse-arc closure and partition into strong components
Pack the condensation DAG into the fewest bounded stages and record boundary arc and wait evidence
workflows.success: Cycle vertices share one stage and the exact minimum stage count is returned with auditable boundaries
workflows.failure: Oversized closures return an executable heuristic plan with explicit lower and upper bounds; budget exhaustion returns nothing partial

workflows.name: Hold and release a stable view
workflows.entry: POST G/pins, GET G/catalog?view=..., DELETE G/pins/{handle}
steps: Allocate a graph-scoped handle to the current immutable revision
Read the earlier state after a write, then release it
workflows.success: Held view stays at the earlier revision until release

workflows.name: Compare two logical graph revisions
steps: Resolve the same-graph pair together
Compare vertex, arc and schema values by identity
workflows.success: Report updated vertices and removed arcs in the requested direction
workflows.failure: A foreign handle cannot select a graph revision

workflows.name: Export and restore an immutable image
steps: Encode the selected revision with digest
Verify the digest and domain constraints before installing under a free name
workflows.success: Restore returns installed revision one and source provenance
workflows.failure: Wrong digest or occupied target never overwrites state

workflows.name: Recover durable heads under exclusive ownership
steps: Acquire directory ownership and inspect installed head files
Validate each image and reconstruct per-head indexes
workflows.success: Head and typed postings survive while handles do not
workflows.failure: Contended ownership or a corrupt installed file blocks startup
